meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络模型，模拟基因敲除与通量分布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做代谢网络建模或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network models, simulate gene knockouts and flux distributions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on constraint-based metabolic modeling or metabolic engineering analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能加载、编辑和运行代谢模型，进行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等计算，并输出生长速率、代谢物通量等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求分析代谢模型、预测细胞生长、设计基因敲除或优化培养基时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型，运行FBA预测生长速率。
say.note: Claude会加载模型并输出优化后的生长速率。

say.text: 对模型中的PFK基因进行单基因敲除模拟。
say.note: Claude会执行敲除并报告敲除后的生长变化。

say.text: 计算模型在厌氧条件下的最小培养基。
say.note: Claude会计算并列出所需的最小培养基组分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load, edit, and run metabolic models, perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout simulations, flux sampling, and output growth rates, metabolite fluxes, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze metabolic models, predict cell growth, design gene knockouts, or optimize growth media.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run FBA to predict growth rate.
say_en.note: Claude will load the model and output the optimized growth rate.

say_en.text: Simulate single gene knockout of PFK in the model.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the knockout and report the growth change.

say_en.text: Calculate minimal medium for the model under anaerobic conditions.
say_en.note: Claude will compute and list the minimal medium components.
